mentions.name: Reflect: Track Anything
mentions.description: An iOS app for tracking and analyzing your life. All data stays local on the device, and it is designed to help users learn more about themselves and their habits.
mentions.problem: Wanting to learn more about oneself and one's personal habits
mentions.audience: Individuals who want to track and analyze their own life and habits
mentions.source_excerpt: I’m making an iOS app [1] that allows you to track and analyze your life. It’s all local to your device and was created to help me learn more about myself and my habits.
